Discovery brief: A team todo app (greenfield).

Goal: a small web app where a team can create shared task lists.

Capabilities: (1) Accounts — sign up, log in, sessions. (2) Task lists — create a list, add tasks, mark done. (3) Sharing — invite a teammate to a list by email.

First slice: a single-user app that can create one list and add tasks (accounts + task lists, sharing deferred).

Dependencies: task lists depend on accounts; sharing depends on both accounts and task lists.
